summary: Phase 149O.1H.6 -- HATP Timestamp Canonicalization Final Independent Verification: verification-only (no production change) final independent re-verification of 149O.1H.5's suffix-independent fractional-precision guard, _FRACTIONAL_SECONDS_RE = re.compile(r'(?<=:\d{2})[.,](\d+)'). Independently reconstructed the exact 149O.1H.5 production diff boundary (3d6b5a9a..66fde5c3): git diff --name-only ... -- src/pcae/ yields exactly one file (src/pcae/core/human_approval_trusted_provenance.py); the functional diff is a single hunk classified LEXICAL_GUARD=1, FRACTION_EXTRACTION=0, UNRELATED=0. Independently reproduced, against an isolated importlib import of the pinned pre-repair commit 3d6b5a9a (never trusting the 149O.1H.5 report's own claims), both historical bypass classes: the non-colon-offset collision (.0000001+00/.0000009+00 both parsing to identical datetime with microsecond=0 under the old regex, which the pre-repair regex.search() confirmed never matches) and the decimal-comma bypass (old regex, anchored on literal '\.', never matches a ','-separated fraction through any suffix including Z). Both classes are now correctly rejected by the live module via both parse_hatp_proof and the direct HumanApprovalProvenanceProof constructor. Ran an independent runtime probe (Python 3.14.5) of datetime.fromisoformat's grammar rather than copying 149O.1H.5's own matrix: confirmed acceptance of Z, colon/non-colon 2-digit/4-digit offsets, offset-seconds fields (+HH:MM:SS/+HHMMSS), offset fractional seconds (+HH:MM:SS.f/+HH:MM:SS,f -- the offset's own sub-second component is silently discarded, never affecting utcoffset()), the ',' decimal separator, and a bare space date/time separator; lowercase 'z' and naive (no-tzinfo) timestamps are independently confirmed rejected by HATP's own _parse_iso_timestamp regardless of fromisoformat's own leniency. Directly and explicitly attacked the new regex's generic (?<=:\d{2}) seconds-field anchor for multi-match / offset-fraction ambiguity (the decisive part of this phase, per the governing prompt): confirmed a single accepted string CAN contain two :\d{2}[.,]\d+ structures (main-timestamp fraction, offset-seconds fraction), and confirmed via direct inspection of the production regex object that re.search()'s leftmost-match semantics structurally guarantee the MAIN timestamp's fraction is always matched first whenever one is present -- the main seconds field always lexically precedes any offset-seconds field in valid ISO-8601 syntax, so no >6-digit main fraction can be hidden by offset content in either direction (swept main-fraction-length x offset-fraction-length combinations: 7-vs-1/6/7 always reject on the main fraction; 6-aligned-vs-7 and 3-vs-7 correctly accept, canonicalizing on the main fraction only, unaffected by the offset's own longer fraction). One NON-BLOCKING observation recorded: a main-fraction-free timestamp whose offset itself carries a >6-digit fractional-seconds component is safely over-rejected (the guard's only available match is the offset's), never an unsafe acceptance -- not a bypass, and not a practically-occurring input shape. Independently swept fraction lengths 0-50 across both '.'/,' separators and every runtime-discovered suffix (60-case cartesian coverage matrix), malformed/near-valid forms (multi-dot, mixed .123,456/,123.456, exponent-like .1e3, signed-fraction .+123/.-123 -- all rejected downstream, with the multi-dot case specifically confirmed to NOT be a guard-miscounting artifact: the guard captures only the first contiguous digit run, '123', never '123456'), losslessness (independently confirmed via source-order inspection -- inspect.getsource shows the guard call precedes the datetime.fromisoformat call textually, not merely behaviorally inferred), injectivity (5 distinct millisecond fractions -> 5 distinct canonical strings, zero collisions), same-instant equivalence across Z/colon/non-colon/comma representations, parser/constructor equivalence over every newly-probed accept and reject form, full B-149O.1H-2 constructor-hardening + closed-schema (13 unknown-field probes) + duplicate-top-level-key + AG3/AG5 wrong-family/unknown-family/missing-field regression (all correctly rejected, B-149O.1H-2 REMAINS INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED CLOSED), and independently reconstructed AG3 and AG5 golden canonical-byte vectors + SHA-256 digests from scratch (without calling canonicalize_hatp_proof_payload) -- both match production output exactly; mutation sensitivity re-confirmed across every signed field. New suite tests/test_phase_149o_1h_6_hatp_timestamp_canonicalization_final_independent_verification.py: 173 passed (Sections A-M: runtime grammar probe, production-boundary reconstruction, isolated pre-repair historical reproduction, live-module rejection confirmation, multi-match/offset-fraction ambiguity attack, suffix-independence property, fraction-length matrix, malformed-form attacks, losslessness/injectivity/equivalence, parser/constructor equivalence, B-149O.1H-2/closed-schema/duplicate-key/AG3-AG5 regression, golden-vector/SHA-256/mutation-sensitivity, purity/dependency/public-API/vocabulary audit). Full regression re-run: Wave-1/2 (test_repository_identity.py + test_hatp_bootstrap_foundation.py + test_phase_149o_1e_...py + test_phase_149o_1f_...py + test_phase_149o_1f_1_...py) 103 passed; 149O.1F.2 90 passed; combined Wave-3-baseline+149O.1H.4+149O.1H.5 (test_phase_149o_1g_...py + test_phase_149o_1h_...py + test_phase_149o_1h_1_...py + test_phase_149o_1h_2_...py + test_phase_149o_1h_3_...py + test_phase_149o_1h_4_...py + test_phase_149o_1h_5_...py) 675 passed; report-trust (test_phase_reports.py + test_phase_reports_cli.py + test_phase_report_trust_hard_fail.py + test_push_phase_report_identity_137f1.py) 201 passed, exact match; HATP contract/plan (test_phase_149o_1c_...py + test_phase_149o_1d_...py) 127 passed, exact match; RAE/Permission-Broker/agent broad selection (-k 'rae or permission_broker or agent') 1 failed / 5399 passed (test_phase_148f_..._test_permission_broker_consumer_scope_inventory, the same known pre-existing failure), RAE canonical-provenance suite run directly 4 failed / 13 passed (same 4 known pre-existing B-149O-1..4-related forgery findings already OPEN), combined pre-existing-failure total 5, matching the established baseline exactly, zero new failures; Fast Green (-m fast_green -n auto) 4531 passed, identical to the entering baseline, no regression.
